metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for ModelFlow: framework development, model building and model use.

plugins.name: modelflow-user
plugins.description: For people who run existing ModelFlow models such as the World Bank MFMod models: install, load, scenarios, results, attribution and reports.

plugins.name: modelflow-dev
plugins.description: For developers of the ModelFlow framework itself: architecture, ng solvers, code generation, design notes and solver regression.

plugins.name: modelflow-modeller
plugins.description: For people who build and maintain models in ModelFlow: equations, FRML options, Makemodel, estimation, data, structure, solver tuning, importing and debugging.
